value.summary: This pull request switches the default scan and deep model to GLM 5.2, adds a `reasoning_effort` config field with corresponding gateway logic and tests, and prices several new models in the pricing table. The test coverage is thorough — the new `reasoning_options` function has unit tests, a wire test connects config to gateway, and the pricing table has a regression test that catches any unpriced model the defaults select. The behavioural changes are fronted by tests that would fail on a silent regression. The change looks sound and is safe to merge.
